evidence.claim: `_updatePauseDuration` lacks a paused-state check and unconditionally resets pauseStartTime to 0, so calling it while paused silently unpauses the contract.
evidence.support_reason: `_updatePauseDuration` (ConfigurablePause.sol:104-119) has no `whenNotPaused`/`paused()` check and calls `_setPauseTime(0)` at line 113 unconditionally, which clears `pauseStartTime` and thus unpauses (paused() at line 70 returns false). It is reachable via the constructor (Timelock.sol:297) and via `updatePauseDuration` (Timelock.sol:982-988), which is `onlyTimelock`.
